thread:
Aisha S: quick note — saw p99 spikes on small requests this morning when we had a sustained microburst. looks like the stream synchronizer's reconciliation is delaying fast-path drains
Tom K: ugh, saw that on the dashboard. is it the reconciliation frequency or how we reify windows?
Aisha S: my hunch: when a burst arrives, we hold a tiny lead window to batch, but reconcile later which forces extra queuing for sub-50-token requests
Priya R: can you paste the telemetry? curious if it's KV cache misses or enqueue wait time
Aisha S: pasted a short extract — headroom shows quick fill then a ~30-60ms stall before reconcile hook fires; KV hit-rate steady
infra-bot: deploy/metrics snapshot: stream-sync.reconcile_count=1200, reconcile_latency_ms.p95=42, request_wait_ms.p99=118
Marco L: sounds like reconcile latency, not cache. if the synchronizer waits for a full-window heuristic we add tail latency for tiny reqs
Tom K: do we have a soft-reconcile vs hard-reconcile knob? iirc there was a PR for graceful drain handshake
Priya R: there is a flag: `stream_sync.reconcile_mode = "batch|soft|immediate"` but currently we default to `soft` which waits for a grace window
Aisha S: right. i'm thinking of an adaptive policy: if incoming QPS spikes and median seq_len < X, shorten grace window for matching lanes
Marco L: propose: heuristics based on recent inter-arrival times + lane-weighted median. something cheap to compute at admission
Tom K: nit: keep a cap to avoid oscillation. i.e., don't shrink below 5ms unless we see repeated success for N cycles
Priya R: also watch for cost regression — too-aggressive shrinking increases small-batch inefficiency (more kernel launch overhead)
Aisha S: agreed. experiment plan: A/B on a single shard with policy variants 
Aisha S: config example we're going to try:
```
stream_sync: 
  reconcile_mode: adaptive
  base_grace_ms: 20
  min_grace_ms: 5
  scale_window_sec: 10
  shrink_on_spike: true
```
Tom K: metric targets: p50/p95/p99 latency for <50 tokens; batching efficiency (tokens per batch); tail error rate 
Marco L: add rollback triggers: if batching efficiency drops >8% or GPU op-count rises >5% then auto-revert 
Priya R: will add dashboards and alert thresholds. local perf harness first, then canary 5% traffic
Aisha S: one more thing — lifecycle: when a lane goes idle we need a fast-evict path to avoid holding headroom forever. otherwise adaptively shrinking still keeps stale reservations
Marco L: yeah, propose `idle_release_ms` per-lane based on recent utilization
Tom K: love it. i'll sketch a quick prototype for admission + reconcile daemon tomorrow
Aisha S: thanks. action items: Tom prototype, Priya dashboards + rollback rules, Marco lane idle proposal, i'll run canary plan
Priya R: noted — will post the dashboard links once done :thumbsup:
Marco L: FYI i captured this as a short RFC follow-up in the scheduler backlog
Aisha S: cool. ping me in the thread when prototype PR lands
infra-bot: reminder: create canary rollout ticket #INF-1842 if deploying adaptive reconcile to prod
